$comment: DOCUMENTS THE CMP/WASM PLAYER CANNOT DRAW YET, temporarily allowed past the gate design-artifacts.yml enforces. Every entry names the player gap and expires, because an allowlist that does not expire is a gate that has been switched off. An entry whose id no longer exists is WORSE than no entry: it protects nothing while making the list look maintained, which is how this file came to hold six dead ids from before the #116 taxonomy fold (old component names, 200dp/320dp frames) while eight live failures blocked every remote-m3 publish from 2026-08-29 15:50 onward. Take ids from the lane's own output — the `CMP/Wasm: n/m rendered` block prints them — rather than from previews.json, whose spelling of the frame differs.
